verdict.rationale: Pylon's knowledge base and training-data docs mention connecting external knowledge sources (pylon-docs-22, pylon-docs-23), and product-data sync can be disabled mid-run (pylon-docs-8), implying some sync mechanism exists, but there is no documentation of a re-sync schedule, change-detection triggers, or automatic re-indexing cadence for knowledge sources. missing for 10: explicit scheduling/frequency controls for knowledge source re-sync, change-detection or webhook-triggered re-sync of external knowledge, and any evidence contradicting or confirming this works hands-on.
